Only 23% of the 4,441 active remote jobs on Loker Dollar actually disclose their pay.

That leaves 3,441 listings (77%) with compensation kept private. Here is what the latest snapshot of the remote USD job market shows.

2,753 roles (62%) are open to applicants anywhere in the world, so the pool of location-agnostic work is real for Indonesian talent.

Most in-demand skills across 4,282 analysed listings:
- Communication: 1,662 (39%)
- AI: 517 (12%)
- Leadership: 416 (10%)
- Sales: 363 (8%)
- Project Management: 313 (7%)
- Data Analysis: 287 (7%)

AI is the fastest-growing requirement. Not yet universal, but worth adding to your profile.

1,560 distinct companies are hiring. Five stand out: Neo Financial, TELUS Health, IDG, Hitachi, and Jobgether. Only one, Neo Financial's remote bilingual client services role at $5/hour, publishes a rate.

The missing pay figures do not mean low wages. Many firms expect candidates to negotiate.

Filter Loker Dollar by 'Open to worldwide remote applicants' to see all 2,753 roles before they close.

Full breakdown: https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/global-remote-jobs-2026
